mechanism: Azathioprine is metabolized by xanthine oxidase and allopurinol inhibits this enzyme; cefuroxime may increase azathioprine levels indirectly through renal function changes and both drugs can affect hematologic parameters.
action: Monitor complete blood count regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate renal function monitoring as both drugs are renally cleared; no dose adjustment typically required but assess for signs of azathioprine toxicity.
